name: Yumikura Neji
source:
A super-fast runner, Neji is the ace of the track and field club. Due to his cheerful disposition and smile, he has many friends and is like the life of his classroom. Though his future in track and field sports is promising, his strong will and sharp tongue can cause problems.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/neji.html]official website profile[/URL].]
